items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: him and Strayhorn was built for that.

ctx.x: Duke Ellington would write things, and he would put things together like he's building something, (inaudible) build a house -- this is good, I'll do this.
And that's what he would do with his music. He was just like -- him and Strayhorn was built for that.
They knew what an instrument could do. That's a good thing -- knowing what a trumpet can do and what a trumpet can't do.
